description: Fires when the opponent owns the lower-centre staircase: their stones on the bottom of column 3, the second row of columns 3 and 4, and the third row of column 5 (the diagonal (0,3)-(1,4)-(2,5) pointing at (3,6)), usually with my stone on top of column 4 at row 2 and cell (1,2) not theirs. Stronger at odd ply (I am second player) and later in the game. The same stones owned by me do not fire it.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero moves any column's probability by at most about 4 points.
notes: Poisoned-column / threat hypothesis failed (F1 0.14). Minimal pairs: removing their (0,3) or (1,4) kills firing, (2,5) and (1,3) add, my (2,4) adds; mirror diagonal does nothing; same stones as mine (even ply, I am first) give ~0. Best dev F1 0.445 (P 0.46, R 0.43, AUROC 0.71), sim share 0.20 with a weighted cell count plus odd-ply bonus. Misses are heterogeneous and the activation flickers with the last move, so the description covers only part of the firing. Two score calls were wasted on accidental reruns. Synthesis revised after orchestrator audit: two original sequences passed through a completed four (moves 26 and 24); replaced with sequences checked so no move completes a four (8.072, 8.010).
